title: [daily-reply-dust] dailyReplyDustFileKey: characterization test for the daily grouped file key
body:
Target: PeaceG03/PeaceSTOCKS

add a characterization test for dailyReplyDustFileKey in src/daily-reply-dust.ts: daily file keys
- dailyReplyDustFileKey("2026-10-13") is "permanent/daily-reply-dust/2026-10-13/grouped-daily.rdust"
- dailyReplyDustFileKey("2026-10-1") throws INVALID_SESSION_DATE

(Builder pre-file, TEST_CASE_EXISTING, public-test-case-existing-v1): Peace's task (source: peace). The daily grouped file key is only used round-trip through a store (get/head of the same key); its literal layout and the INVALID_SESSION_DATE guard are untested; this pins them. Production safety: test-only: one new src/*.test.ts file only: no source edits, no fix commit. Job B grades it fix-free: the test passes on the current code and fails with the function body stubbed. The running scanner chain is unchanged. A box dry-run on PeaceSTOCKS 663e31e (Workspace main 129a084, live 26-rule approved list, Node 22) built exactly one candidate (public-test-case-existing-v1); a local Job B run graded it COUNTS (the new test passes on the current code and fails with dailyReplyDustFileKey stubbed); suite 585/585 with all eleven new tests of this batch, all 4 typechecks ok. Disjoint file: each task in this batch creates its own new test file. Expected COUNTS.)
